_comment: Rebuilt 2026-09-14. The previous contents planned v7.4 for 31 Dec 2026 and bars for
work that had already shipped — v7.4.0 went out on 2026-09-13, so the file was
planning a version that existed. A plan that describes the past is worse than no plan.
What is here now comes from ROADMAP.md's own open items, nothing invented: the one
open Now item and the five open Next ones. The DATES are the assumption — they place
those items on the monthly cadence below, one milestone per month end. Move them when
you disagree; the items themselves are yours.
`Later` items carry no dates on purpose. They are parked behind an `unpark:` condition
and dating them would turn a condition into a deadline.
